Variants.Content: Founded in Jerusalem, the Knights Hospitaller combined monastic vows with martial discipline. Clad in black mantles bearing the white eight-pointed cross, they garrisoned colossal fortresses like Krak des Chevaliers and Margat, while running advanced medical infirmaries in Acre to tend wounded crusaders and pilgrims.

Exempt from secular jurisdictions, the Grand Master answered solely to the Pope. Their hospices treated wounded combatants with medicinal salves and clean bandages, embodying Christian charity alongside feudal prowess.

Do not mistake their healing vows for softness. In the battle line, a Hospitaller wedge of barded warhorses strikes like a thunderbolt, bound by solemn vows never to retreat so long as their banner flies.
